title: Version 0.82.1 Release
description: Aider released version 0.82.1 in April 2025, continuing their series of AI coding assistant updates. The repository moved from paul-gauthier/aider to Aider-AI/aider organization.

title: Background Agents in Slack, BugBot, and Cursor 1.0
description: Cursor launched version 1.0 with Background Agents in Slack integration, BugBot for automatic code review, Background Agent access for all users, Jupyter Notebook support, Memories feature, and one-click MCP setup with OAuth support.

title: Copilot Cloud Agent and GPT-5.4 Models
description: GitHub released Copilot cloud agent for research, planning, and coding, along with GPT-5.4 mini generally available, Copilot SDK in public preview, and organization custom instructions GA. Multiple improvements including Copilot CLI BYOK support and coding agent session management.

title: Version 2.1.110 - TUI Mode and Push Notifications
description: Claude Code 2.1.110 added `/tui` command for flicker-free rendering, push notification tool for Remote Control, `/focus` command toggle, improved `/plugin` interface, and various performance improvements including faster startup and reduced memory usage.

title: Cascade AI Agent and MCP Integration
description: Windsurf features Cascade - an AI agent combining deep codebase understanding, advanced tools, and real-time awareness. Includes Windsurf Previews for live website editing, MCP integration, Tab-to-Jump navigation, Supercomplete, and Command features.
